stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait. The game asks for landscape itself and prompts you to turn the phone when it needs it.
stumbles.why: Unclear how a game can show landscape when rotation is locked, and it conflicts with step 4's instruction to turn the phone to landscape yourself.

stumbles.quote: Tap 'Start engine', then turn the phone to landscape when the game prompts you.
stumbles.why: With rotation locked in portrait (step 1), it's unclear whether the layout will actually change when you turn the phone, or how the prompt works.

stumbles.quote: Hold the phone the way you want to drive.
stumbles.why: Vague about which orientation or angle is meant, and it doesn't say how this fits with the landscape instruction.

stumbles.quote: Tilt the top of the phone away from you to accelerate.
stumbles.why: In landscape, 'the top' is ambiguous. It could mean the edge that was the top in portrait or the edge that is up in landscape.

stumbles.quote: whatever tilt the phone has at that moment counts as straight and level.
stumbles.why: It doesn't say whether the phone should be held still, or whether you can recalibrate if you start from a bad angle.

point: To play Tilt Rally, open it on a phone with a motion sensor, choose a track in portrait, then turn to landscape and steer and accelerate by tilting from whatever angle you hold when the lights go out.
